title: Classic White Bread
desc: Simple everyday loaf with a soft crumb and crisp top.
steps: Mix flour, water and yeast. Rest 15 min.
Add salt and butter. Knead until smooth and elastic.
Bulk ferment 60–90 min, until doubled.
Shape, place in loaf tin, proof 45–60 min.
Bake until deep golden and fully set.

title: Ciabatta
desc: Overnight ciabatta with open crumb and crisp crust.
steps: Mix flour, yeast and most of the water. Rest 20–30 min.
Mix in salt with remaining water; add oil if using.
Do 3–4 stretch-and-folds, 30 min apart.
Cover and refrigerate 12–18 hr.
Warm 60–90 min, tip onto a floured surface and divide gently.
Proof 30–45 min. Bake 10 min with steam at 250°C, then 12–18 min at 220°C.

title: Focaccia
desc: Airy interior, olive-oil crust, easy tray bake.
steps: Mix flour, water and yeast. Rest 20 min.
Add salt and half the oil. Fold until cohesive.
Bulk ferment 2 hr with 2–3 folds.
Transfer to oiled tray. Proof 60–90 min.
Dimple, add remaining oil and salt. Bake until deeply golden.

title: French Baguette
desc: Lean dough, crisp shell, creamy open crumb.
steps: Mix flour, water and yeast. Rest 20 min.
Add salt and knead briefly.
Bulk ferment 2–3 hr, or refrigerate overnight after 60 min.
Divide, pre-shape, rest 20 min, then shape baguettes.
Proof 40–50 min, score, and bake with steam.

title: Soft Sandwich Bread
desc: Tender enriched loaf for toast and sandwiches.
steps: Mix flour, milk and yeast. Rest 10 min.
Add salt, sugar and butter. Knead until smooth.
Bulk ferment 60–90 min.
Shape tightly and proof in loaf tin 45–60 min.
Bake until golden; cool before slicing.

title: Rustic Overnight Bread
desc: Mix at night, bake the next day. Crisp crust and open crumb.
steps: Mix everything until no dry flour remains.
Cover and ferment 12–18 hr at cool room temperature.
Shape gently and rest 45–60 min.
Score and bake with steam or in a preheated Dutch oven.

title: Soft Burger Buns
desc: Soft, rich buns that stay light but hold a burger well.
steps: Mix flour, milk and yeast. Rest 10 min.
Add salt, sugar, egg and butter. Knead smooth.
Bulk ferment 60–75 min.
Divide into 8, shape tight balls and proof 45–60 min.
Brush with egg or milk and bake until golden.

title: Dinner Rolls
desc: Soft pull-apart rolls for dinner or sandwiches.
steps: Mix flour, milk and yeast. Rest 10 min.
Add salt, sugar and butter. Knead until elastic.
Bulk ferment 60–75 min.
Divide into 12, shape and place close together in a tray.
Proof 45–60 min and bake until golden.

title: Simple Sourdough
desc: Straightforward sourdough with a flexible hydration range.
steps: Mix flours and most of the water. Rest 30 min.
Add starter and salt; mix thoroughly.
Bulk ferment 4–6 hr with folds during the first 2 hr.
Shape and cold proof 8–12 hr.
Score and bake in a hot Dutch oven or with steam.

title: Cinnabon-Style Cinnamon Rolls
desc: Soft cinnamon rolls with cream-cheese frosting.
steps: Mix flour, yeast, sugar, milk, eggs and yolks. Knead 5 min.
Work in butter and salt; knead 8–10 min until elastic. Rise 1–1½ hr.
Divide dough in 2 and roll each to about 40 × 30 cm.
Spread butter; add brown sugar, cinnamon and salt. Roll up and cut 10–12 pieces per log.
Proof 40–60 min. Bake at 180°C conventional / 170°C fan for 22–28 min.
Beat frosting ingredients smooth and spread over warm rolls.

title: Sourdough Spelt Brioche with Crumble Topping
desc: Rich, pillowy spelt sourdough brioche cold-fermented overnight and baked under a golden buttery crumble.
steps: Mix all dough ingredients together and knead until smooth, uniform, soft, and elastic (this will take a little time). Do not add extra flour while kneading; if sticky, lightly oil your hands with rapeseed or canola oil.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let the dough rest for 1–2 hours at room temperature.
Cover tightly and place in a cool place or refrigerator for long fermentation (approximately 14 hours, or overnight).
Rub together 100 g flour, 50 g butter, and 50 g sugar with your fingertips in a bowl until crumbly.
Transfer the risen dough to a greased baking tin, sprinkle generously with the crumble topping, and leave to rise again until doubled in volume.
Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Bake for 10 minutes at 200°C, then reduce temperature to 180°C and bake for another 30 minutes until golden.

title: Monica's Bread
desc: Rustic spelt and wholegrain rye sourdough loaf with a beautifully browned, crackly crust, baked with steam.
steps: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly in a bowl. You can optionally fold in sunflower seeds, flaxseed, or a splash of olive oil if desired.

Leave to rise for approximately 3–6 hours depending on room temperature until roughly doubled in size (alternatively, prepare in the evening and cold-ferment covered in the refrigerator overnight or up to 2 days, then bring out to rise before baking).
Transfer the dough into a greased loaf tin.
Preheat the oven to 200°C and place an ovenproof dish filled with water on the oven floor to create steam for a nicely browned, crisp crust.
Bake at 200°C for 50 minutes until deeply golden and sounding hollow when tapped on the bottom.

title: Drømmekage / Sjónvarpskaka
desc: Soft vanilla cake with warm brown-sugar coconut topping.
steps: Beat eggs, sugar and vanilla until pale and fluffy.
Fold in flour and baking powder. Mix in melted butter and milk.
Pour into lined 30 × 40 cm tray. Bake 30–35 min.
Melt topping butter, brown sugar and milk; stir in coconut.
Spread over cake and bake about 10 min more until golden.

title: Bounty Cake
desc: Gotterí Bounty kaka — coconut cake with chocolate cream.
steps: Beat egg whites with 140 g icing sugar until thick and fluffy.
Fold in 140 g coconut. Bake at 150°C for about 40 min. Cool.
Melt butter and chocolate together over a water bath. Set aside briefly.
Beat egg yolks with 60 g icing sugar until pale and light.
Fold in the chocolate mixture. Spread over the cooled cake and sprinkle with coconut.

title: Carrot Cake
desc: Moist spiced carrot cake with simple cream-cheese frosting.
steps: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and cinnamon.
Whisk eggs and oil; fold into dry ingredients, then add carrot.
Bake until set and a skewer comes out clean. Cool fully.
Beat cream cheese, butter and icing sugar. Spread over cake.

title: Simple Chocolate Cake
desc: Deep chocolate flavour, soft crumb, straightforward method.
steps: Mix flour, cocoa, sugar and baking powder.
Whisk in eggs, milk and oil. Stir in hot coffee last.
Pour into tin and bake until just set.
Cool before slicing or frosting.

title: Pavlova with Lemon Curd
desc: Crisp meringue shell, soft centre and sharp lemon curd.
steps: Whip egg whites to soft peaks. Add sugar gradually until glossy and dissolved.
Fold in cornstarch, acid and vanilla. Shape on baking paper.
Heat oven to 150°C, put pavlova in, immediately reduce to 120°C and bake 75–90 min. Cool in switched-off oven.
For curd, whisk yolks, sugar, zest and juice over low heat until thick.
Remove from heat and whisk in butter. Chill, then spoon onto pavlova.

title: Apple Crumb Cake
desc: Moist apple cake with cinnamon crumb topping.
steps: Heat oven to 175°C. Grease and line a 23 cm pan.
Mix dry cake ingredients. Whisk eggs, oil, buttermilk and vanilla separately.
Combine wet and dry just until mixed; fold in apples.
Mix crumb flour, brown sugar and cinnamon; stir in melted butter. Scatter over batter.
Bake 35–40 min until a skewer comes out clean.

title: Chocolate Orange Cheesecake
desc: Baked chocolate cheesecake with orange and ganache topping.
steps: Crush biscuits, mix with melted butter and press into 18 cm tin. Chill.
Whisk sugar, orange zest and eggs briefly. Mix in mascarpone, cream cheese and sour cream.
Mix in melted chocolate and cocoa. Pour over base.
Bake in a water bath at 160°C for about 80 min; centre should wobble slightly. Cool, then chill overnight.
Heat cream and honey; pour over topping chocolate. Stir smooth, add butter and pour over cheesecake.

title: Date Cake with Caramel Sauce
desc: Soft date cake served with warm caramel sauce.
steps: Heat oven to 180°C. Cover dates with water, boil, remove from heat 3–4 min and mash lightly. Stir in baking soda.
Beat butter and sugar fluffy; add eggs one at a time.
Mix in flour, cinnamon, salt, baking powder and vanilla, then fold in date mixture.
Bake 35–40 min.
For sauce, boil butter, cream and brown sugar together until slightly thickened but still pourable.

title: Espumilla de Frutilla
desc: Light strawberry foam dessert.
steps: Put egg white and about 2 tbsp sugar in a heatproof bowl over a bain-marie.
Whisk about 10 min, heating mixture to at least 72°C.
Add remaining sugar and strawberry purée.
Beat 10–15 min until thick, fluffy and pale pink.

title: Lemon Meringue Cheesecake
desc: Baked lemon cheesecake with lemon curd and meringue.
steps: Bake biscuit crust 7–8 min at 180°C. Reduce oven to 140°C.
Mix cream cheese, sugar, zest and vanilla. Add sour cream, lemon juice and eggs gently; mix in cornstarch.
Pour over crust and bake about 1 hr until edges are set and centre jiggles slightly. Cool gradually and chill at least 5 hr.
Cook lemon curd ingredients gently until thick; chill and spread over cheesecake.
Whisk meringue ingredients over simmering water until sugar dissolves, then beat to stiff glossy peaks. Spread over curd and torch lightly.

title: Caesar Salad Dressing
desc: Classic creamy Caesar dressing with anchovy and Parmesan.
steps: Whisk yolk, anchovy, garlic, Dijon, lemon juice and Worcestershire together.
Slowly drizzle in olive oil while whisking until emulsified.
Stir in Parmesan. Season with pepper and salt if needed.

title: Wild Blueberry Glazed Cheesecake
desc: Baked cheesecake with a digestive base, blueberry filling and set blueberry jelly topping.
steps: Heat oven to 180°C. Crush biscuits, mix with brown sugar and melted butter, press into base and sides of a 24–26 cm springform. Bake 5 min.
Beat cream cheese, lemon juice, blueberry jam, sugar and eggs until smooth.
Pour over the pre-baked base and bake 25 min. Cool at room temperature then refrigerate several hours.
Bring blueberry juice to a boil with gelatin powder as directed, add food colouring if desired. Pour jelly over the cold cake and decorate with fresh blueberries.

title: Vanilla Dream with Warm Berry Sauce
desc: No-bake vanilla cheesecake finished with a glossy warm mixed berry sauce.
steps: Melt butter, crush biscuits, mix together and press into a 20 cm springform. Chill.
Beat cream cheese and sugar until light. Add vanilla seeds and extract.
Whip cream and fold gently into the cream cheese mixture. Pour over base and chill.
Simmer berries, sugar and lemon juice 10–15 min until saucy. Cool, then pour over the cake.

title: Berry Explosion Cheesecake
desc: No-bake vanilla cheesecake piled sky-high with fresh strawberries, raspberries, blueberries and redcurrants.
steps: Crush biscuits, mix with sugar, salt and melted butter and press into a 25 cm springform.
Beat cream cheese, then mix in icing sugar, skyr, vanilla extract, vanilla seeds and salt.
Whip cream and fold into the mixture. Pour over base and refrigerate overnight.
Top generously with fresh mixed berries before serving.

title: Oreo Cream Cheese Swirl Brownies
desc: Fudgy dark chocolate brownies swirled with vanilla cream cheese and crushed Oreos.
steps: Heat oven to 175°C. Melt butter with sugar.
Beat cream cheese, icing sugar and vanilla until smooth.
Beat eggs, add butter-sugar mixture, flour, cocoa, salt, melted chocolate and 12 crushed Oreos.
Spread half the brownie batter in the tin, pour cream cheese mixture over, dot remaining batter on top and swirl with a skewer. Crush 4 Oreos over the top. Bake 25 min.

title: Triple-Layer Oreo Cloud Cups
desc: Three-layer no-bake cheesecake in glasses — pure vanilla, dark chocolate and crushed Oreo.
steps: Crush Oreos for base. Melt chocolate with 50 ml cream and cool.
Whip 500 ml cream. Beat cream cheese, icing sugar and vanilla, then fold in whipped cream.
Divide into 3 portions: leave one plain, fold chocolate into one, fold roughly crushed Oreos into one.
Layer in glasses: Oreo crumbs → white layer → Oreo layer → chocolate layer. Chill 2–3 hours. Top with whipped cream and whole Oreos.

title: Toblerone & Raspberry Swirl Cheesecake
desc: No-bake Toblerone cheesecake with a vivid raspberry swirl on an Oreo base.
steps: Press crushed Oreos and melted butter into a 20 cm springform. Chill 1 hour.
Soak gelatin leaves, dissolve in 60 ml boiling water and cool to room temperature.
Beat cream cheese and sugar; add cocoa, gelatin, melted Toblerone and vanilla. Fold in lightly whipped cream.
Pour into tin, drizzle raspberry purée over and drag a knife through for a swirl. Chill until set.

title: White Chocolate & Daim Crunch Cheesecake
desc: No-bake white Toblerone cheesecake loaded with crushed Daim on a spiced Bastogne base.
steps: Press crushed Bastogne biscuits and melted butter into a 20 cm springform. Chill.
Soak gelatin leaves then dissolve in 60 ml boiling water. Melt white Toblerone.
Beat cream cheese, sugar, icing sugar and vanilla sugar. Mix in gelatin and melted Toblerone.
Fold in whipped cream and crushed Daim. Pour into tin and chill at least 4 hours.

title: Lotus Biscoff Velvet Cheesecake
desc: No-bake Biscoff cheesecake on a cinnamon biscuit base with a warm Biscoff drizzle.
steps: Press crushed biscuits and melted butter into an 18–20 cm springform. Chill.
Beat cream cheese and Biscoff spread until smooth. Add icing sugar and vanilla sugar.
Fold in whipped cream, pour into tin and chill until set.
Warm remaining Biscoff spread slightly and drizzle over the top with a sprinkle of biscuit crumbs.

title: Strawberry & Dark Chocolate Cheesecake
desc: No-bake strawberry cheesecake on an Oreo base, crowned with whole berries and a dark chocolate drizzle.
steps: Press crushed Oreos and melted butter into a 20 cm springform.
Soak gelatin then dissolve in 50 ml boiling water. Beat cream cheese, sugar, icing sugar and vanilla sugar. Add strawberry purée and gelatin.
Fold in whipped cream and pour over base. Chill until set.
Arrange whole strawberries over the top and drizzle with melted dark chocolate.

title: Lemon Curd Cheesecake Cups
desc: Light no-bake lemon curd cheesecake served in individual glasses on an oat biscuit crumb.
steps: Crush biscuits, mix with melted butter and divide between glasses.
Beat cream cheese, sugar and vanilla sugar. Stir in lemon curd gently.
Fold in whipped cream. Pipe into glasses and top with a spoonful of lemon curd and a pinch of biscuit crumbs.

title: Espresso Martini Cheesecake Glasses
desc: No-bake espresso and dark chocolate cheesecake in glasses, finished with coffee beans.
steps: Crush Oreos with melted butter and press into the base of each glass.
Beat cream cheese, sugar, cocoa and vanilla sugar. Add espresso and melted chocolate and mix well.
Fold in whipped cream with a spatula. Pipe into glasses, chill, then dust with cocoa and garnish with coffee beans.

title: Caramel Pecan & Coffee Cheesecake
desc: No-bake cheesecake set with coffee gelatin, topped with hand-caramelised pecans.
steps: Melt sugar and butter in a pan, toss in pecans, cool on baking paper and roughly chop.
Blitz biscuits and 100 g of the caramel pecans in a food processor, mix with melted butter and press into a 20 cm springform.
Dissolve soaked gelatin in 50 ml hot coffee and cool. Beat cream cheese, brown sugar, icing sugar and vanilla seeds. Stir in gelatin.
Fold in whipped cream. Pour into tin, chill until set and top with remaining caramel pecans.

title: Torched Meringue Dark Chocolate Cheesecake
desc: Dark chocolate and liquorice cheesecake crowned with a blowtorch-toasted Italian meringue.
steps: Press crushed biscuits and melted butter into a 20 cm springform. Chill.
Dissolve soaked gelatin in 50 ml boiling water. Beat cream cheese and sugar; add vanilla, melted chocolate and gelatin. Fold in whipped cream and chopped liquorice balls. Chill until set.
Beat egg whites with cream of tartar, sugar, vanilla and salt to stiff glossy peaks. Pipe over the cheesecake and torch with a blowtorch until golden.

title: White Chocolate & Orange Cheesecake
desc: No-bake white Toblerone cheesecake with a fresh orange and vanilla gelatin set.
steps: Press crushed biscuits and melted butter into a 20 cm springform. Chill.
Heat orange juice and zest to a simmer, dissolve soaked gelatin in it and cool to room temperature.
Melt Toblerone. Beat cream cheese, sugar and vanilla seeds; mix in Toblerone and orange gelatin.
Fold in whipped cream and pour into tin. Chill until set.

title: Celebration White Chocolate Daim Cheesecake
desc: Festive no-bake white Toblerone cheesecake studded with Daim bites — party perfect.
steps: Press crushed Oreos and melted butter into a 20 cm springform.
Dissolve soaked gelatin in 60 ml boiling water. Beat cream cheese, sugar, icing sugar and vanilla sugar; add gelatin and melted Toblerone.
Fold in whipped cream and chopped Daim bites. Pour into tin and chill overnight.

title: Brownie, Black Cherry & Meringue Bomb
desc: Fudgy brownie base topped with cherry-swirled cheesecake and a torched meringue crown.
steps: Bake brownie base: melt butter and chocolate, mix in sugar, vanilla, egg and flour. Bake at 160°C for 25 min. Cool.
Dissolve soaked gelatin in 40 ml boiling water. Beat cream cheese, sugar, icing sugar and vanilla seeds. Add gelatin and whipped cream, then swirl in cherry jam. Pour over brownie. Chill.
Beat egg whites with salt and icing sugar to stiff peaks. Pipe over the cheesecake and torch until golden.

title: Caramel Rolo Cheesecake
desc: No-bake vanilla cheesecake generously studded with halved Rolo caramel chocolates.
steps: Press crushed biscuits and melted butter into a 22 cm springform.
Soak gelatin, dissolve in 50 ml boiling water, cool to room temperature.
Beat cream cheese, sugar, icing sugar and vanilla seeds. Mix in gelatin.
Fold in whipped cream and halved Rolo pieces. Pour into tin and chill until set.

title: Dumle Caramel Cheesecake Glasses
desc: Light vanilla cheesecake cups with a silky Dumle caramel sauce and fresh berry garnish.
steps: Mix crushed Oreos with melted butter and press 1 tbsp into the base of each glass.
Beat cream cheese, sugar and vanilla sugar. Fold in whipped cream and divide between glasses.
Melt Dumle caramels with 100 ml cream in a saucepan, cool to room temperature and spoon over each cheesecake. Garnish with berries.

title: Cinnamon & Brown Sugar Caramel Cheesecake Cups
desc: Vanilla cheesecake glasses on a spiced biscuit crumb with a poured brown-sugar caramel.
steps: Divide crushed biscuits between glasses.
Beat cream cheese, sugar and vanilla seeds. Fold in whipped cream and pipe into glasses.
Melt butter with brown sugar and cream in a saucepan until sugar dissolves. Cool and spoon over each glass.

title: White Chocolate & Fresh Raspberry Cheesecake
desc: Elegant no-bake white Toblerone cheesecake with mashed and fresh raspberries throughout.
steps: Press crushed biscuits and melted butter into an 18–20 cm springform.
Dissolve soaked gelatin in 50 ml boiling water. Beat cream cheese, sugar and icing sugar; add vanilla, melted Toblerone and gelatin.
Fold in whipped cream and mashed raspberries. Chill until set. Top with fresh raspberries and a dusting of icing sugar.

title: Polish Baked Curd Cheesecake
desc: Traditional Sernik — baked with Twaróg curd cheese and finished with a grated cocoa-pastry crumble.
steps: Make pastry: rub butter into flour, cocoa, sugar, baking powder and salt. Mix in egg yolk, sour cream and vanilla to form a dough. Divide 2/3 into the fridge, 1/3 into the freezer. Bake the 2/3 portion blind in a lined springform for 15 min at 180°C.
Beat butter with 6 egg yolks and half the sugar until pale. Mix in Twaróg, vanilla and orange zest.
Whisk 7 egg whites with remaining sugar and custard powder to stiff peaks. Fold carefully into the cheese mixture.
Pour filling over the pre-baked base. Grate the frozen pastry dough over the top. Bake at 180°C for 70 min. Cool in the tin.

title: Dark & Caramel Ganache Cheesecake Cups
desc: Vanilla cheesecake glasses on a cinnamon base, finished with a rich dark and caramel chocolate ganache.
steps: Mix crushed cinnamon biscuits with melted butter and press into glasses.
Beat cream cheese, sugar and vanilla sugar. Fold in whipped cream and pipe into glasses.
Chop chocolates, pour hot cream over, stir until smooth, add maple syrup. Spoon 2 tbsp ganache over each glass.

title: Raspberry Skyr Mousse in Chocolate Bowls
desc: Whipped vanilla skyr and raspberry mousse served in hand-made chocolate bowls on a biscuit base.
steps: Inflate balloons, dip the bottom into melted chocolate coating, set on baking paper and refrigerate. Once firm, pop and remove balloons to reveal chocolate bowls.
Whip cream, then fold vanilla skyr and vanilla seeds in gently.
Mix crushed biscuits with melted butter. Press 1 tbsp into the base of each chocolate bowl.
Divide skyr mixture over the biscuit bases, top with raspberry purée and fresh raspberries.

title: Strawberry Cheesecake in Chocolate Bowls
desc: Strawberry cheesecake mousse served in hand-made dark chocolate bowls — show-stopping party dessert.
steps: Make chocolate bowls: inflate balloons, dip bases into melted chocolate, chill until firm, then pop balloons.
Beat cream cheese with icing sugar and vanilla sugar. Add puréed strawberries, then fold in whipped cream.
Mix crushed biscuits with melted butter and press into the chocolate bowl bases.
Fill bowls with the cheesecake mixture and garnish with fresh strawberries and whipped cream.

title: Strawberry Skyr Cocktail Cups
desc: Layered strawberry skyr cheesecake in glasses with a cooked strawberry glaze and fresh berries.
steps: Cook glaze: heat puréed strawberries, sugar, cornflour and water 5–8 min until thick. Add red food colouring if desired. Cool.
Whip cream. Beat cream cheese, icing sugar and vanilla sugar, fold in whipped cream.
Layer in glasses: crushed biscuit → cream cheese mixture → sliced fresh strawberries → strawberry glaze.

title: Mini Blueberry Skyr Cups
desc: Individual skyr mousse cups with a cooked blueberry sauce and fresh blueberries on a digestive base.
steps: Mix crushed biscuits with melted butter and divide between glasses.
Simmer blueberries, water, sugar, lemon juice and vanilla extract for 10 min until saucy. Cool.
Whip cream and fold vanilla skyr in gently.
Layer glasses: biscuit base → skyr mixture → blueberry sauce → fresh blueberries.

title: Vanilla Skyr with Chocolate Granola & Raspberries
desc: Simple and fresh vanilla skyr mousse cups layered over chocolate granola and topped with raspberries.
steps: Put 2 tbsp of muesli in the base of each glass.
Whip cream and fold vanilla skyr in gently.
Divide skyr mixture between glasses and top with fresh raspberries. Chill 1 hour before serving.

title: Berry Skyr Sheet Cake
desc: Easy layered skyr cake in a serving dish — berry skyr, whipped cream, chopped chocolate and fresh berries.
steps: Crush biscuits, mix with melted butter and press into the base of a serving dish. Chill.
Whip cream and fold skyr in gently with a spatula.
Spread skyr mixture over the base, scatter chopped chocolate and fresh berries on top. Chill 1–2 hours.

title: Chocolate Skyr Mousse Cups
desc: Quick chocolate skyr mousse cups with granola, piped cream and a raspberry garnish.
steps: Whip 400 ml cream and fold skyr gently through. Divide between glasses.
Scatter chocolate muesli over each.
Whip 200 ml cream, pipe on top, dust with cocoa and garnish with raspberries and chocolate shavings.

title: Strawberry Skyr in a Chocolate Rice Krispie Shell
desc: Strawberry skyr mousse set inside a crispy chocolate and golden syrup Rice Krispie shell.
steps: Melt butter, dark chocolate and golden syrup in a saucepan, bring to a simmer for 1 min. Stir in Rice Krispies and press into the base and sides of a 22 cm springform. Chill.
Whip cream to stiff peaks and fold skyr in carefully.
Pour skyr mousse into the Rice Krispie shell. Top with grated white chocolate and fresh strawberries.

title: Icelandic Flag Skyr Dessert
desc: Vanilla skyr mousse on a Prince Polo wafer base, decorated as the Icelandic flag with raspberries and blueberries.
steps: Crush Prince Polo wafers and spread over the base of a large serving tray.
Whip cream; set a little aside in a piping bag. Fold vanilla skyr into the rest and spread over the base.
Decorate to resemble the Icelandic flag: a cross of raspberries down the centre, piped cream dots on the border, and blueberries in the four corners.

title: Lemon & Almond Skyr Cake
desc: Set vanilla skyr cake with lemon and almond notes on a lemon-almond biscuit base.
steps: Press crushed biscuits and melted ghee into a 20–22 cm springform and freeze while making the filling.
Dissolve soaked gelatin in 50 ml hot water and cool.
Whip cream with icing sugar, vanilla sugar and lemon extract. Fold vanilla skyr through, then add gelatin in a thin stream.
Pour into tin and chill overnight. Garnish with flaked almonds and lemon slices.

title: Summer Berry Skyr Cake
desc: Gelatin-set skyr cake with strawberry and blueberry skyr on an oat biscuit base.
steps: Press crushed oat biscuits and melted butter into a 20–22 cm springform and freeze.
Heat milk and dissolve soaked gelatin in it. Cool.
Whip cream with icing sugar and vanilla sugar. Fold berry skyr through, then add gelatin in a thin stream.
Pour into tin and chill at least 5 hours. Top with fresh berries and chopped dark chocolate.

title: Berry Bliss Skyr Cake
desc: Simple layered berry skyr cake in a serving dish with fresh berries and dark chocolate.
steps: Mix crushed Bastogne biscuits with melted butter and press into the base of a serving dish. Chill.
Whip cream and fold skyr through gently.
Spread over the biscuit base and decorate with fresh berries and chopped dark chocolate.

title: Berry Skyr Cups with Chocolate Pebbles
desc: Berry skyr mousse cups on a cinnamon biscuit and chocolate pebble base, topped with more chocolate pebbles.
steps: Blitz biscuits and Nóakropp together, mix with melted butter and divide between glasses.
Whip cream to stiff peaks and fold skyr through gently.
Pipe into glasses and top generously with Nóakropp. Chill 1 hour.

title: Vanilla Skyr with Salted Liquorice Caramel
desc: Vanilla skyr mousse cups with a salty-sweet liquorice caramel and crushed Oreo base.
steps: Chop liquorice caramel balls. Mix half with crushed Oreos and put 1 tbsp in the base of each glass.
Whip cream and fold vanilla skyr through gently.
Pipe into glasses and top with the remaining chopped liquorice caramel balls.

title: Rose Swirl Chocolate Celebration Cake
desc: Four-layer rich chocolate sponge layered with dark chocolate buttercream and crowned with piped vanilla buttercream roses.
steps: Cream together granulated sugar and butter until light and fluffy.
Add the eggs one at a time, scraping down the sides.
Beat this mixture on high speed until airy, then add the vanilla drops.
Mix together the dry ingredients (flour, cocoa, baking soda, and salt) and alternate adding them with the sour cream.
Gently stir until well combined, then add the boiling water.
Pour into cake pans (two 26-30cm pans, or three 20cm pans, then each layer can be split into two using a thread/cake cutter).
Bake for about 35 minutes at 170°C.
Place all ingredients except powdered sugar and cocoa into a mixer bowl and mix well.
Mix the powdered sugar and cocoa together and gently add to the mixture, scraping down the sides, and beat until the frosting is smooth and creamy.
Place all ingredients except powdered sugar into a mixer bowl and mix well.
Gently add the powdered sugar to the mixture, scraping down the sides, and beat until the frosting is smooth and creamy.

Tint with your desired food coloring. If you want two-toned roses, you can smear a little food coloring/darker frosting onto one or more sides of the piping bag. Then, fill with the lighter color and pipe roses using a 2D or 1M Wilton piping tip (I prefer 2D).

title: Triple-Layer Chocolate Fudge Cake
desc: Deep and moist chocolate sponge layers filled and frosted with a glossy chocolate fudge buttercream.
steps: Pour the hot coffee over the cocoa powder, stir well, and let it cool on the counter for 15–20 minutes while you prepare the other ingredients.
Mix the flour, baking soda, baking powder, and salt together in a bowl and set aside.
Preheat the oven to 175°C and grease three 20 cm cake pans thoroughly.
Whisk together the eggs, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy.
Add the mayonnaise and vanilla extract and beat until smooth.
Alternately add the coffee mixture and the flour mixture, beating until smooth and combined.
Divide evenly between the pans and bake for 30–35 minutes. Cool in the pans for 15 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
Heat the dark chocolate, golden syrup, and double cream together in the microwave until melted, stirring every 20 seconds.
Beat the butter, salt, vanilla extract, and half of the icing sugar together until smooth.
Pour in the melted chocolate mixture and beat, then add the remaining icing sugar.
Add a small splash of extra cream if needed until the frosting is light, glossy, and spreadable.

title: Golden Easter Egg Nest Cake
desc: Rich chocolate cake layered with silky vanilla buttercream and crowned with a dark chocolate ganache drip.
steps: Mix the cake mix according to the package instructions and, just at the end, add the melted dark chocolate along with the pudding powder and gently fold in. Bake according to instructions. Bake in four 20cm pans. Actually, I only use 3 layers for this cake, so you can make 1.5 recipes or let family members steal the extra layer while it is still warm. Once the layers are cold, split each one in half with a cake cutter so you end with 6 thin layers.
Mix everything together in a mixer bowl and spread between the layers (not on the top layer, though; that gets the yellow buttercream).

Place all ingredients except powdered sugar in a mixer bowl and mix well. Mix the powdered sugar together and gently add to the mixture, scraping down the sides, and beat until the frosting is smooth and creamy.
First, spread an ultra-thin layer of frosting over the entire cake to create a crumb coat and bind all the crumbs, then let it “set.”

Next, spread a thicker layer of yellow buttercream over the base layer and smooth it as much as possible. It is helpful to dip your offset spatula in hot water between smoothing the frosting; this will make it smoother than otherwise.
Chill, and prepare the ganache and chocolate decorations in the meantime.

Chop the dark chocolate. Bring the cream to a boil and pour it over the chocolate; let it sit for about 5 minutes. Stir the mixture together and add the syrup. It is good to use a spoon or a squeeze bottle to take some of the chocolate mixture and drizzle it over the edges so it drips down. Then, spread a generous layer over the top and smooth it out.

Melt the chocolate coating and pour it onto parchment paper on a tray. Spread it out with an offset spatula, sprinkle with a little cake decorating dust before it sets and cools (I used yellow, pink, and a little white). Once set, break it into appropriately sized pieces and stick them into the cake, both on the top and the sides (after the ganache has been poured).
I put a little chocolate on the cake plate to secure the eggs that lie there, but otherwise, you can place the eggs in a pile in the center of the cake and down by one edge.
It is beautiful.

title: Autumn Harvest Spiced Carrot Cake
desc: Warmly spiced carrot and walnut cake filled with tangy cream cheese frosting and autumn decorations.
ingredients: -2 x heill ferskur ananas (fer eftir fjölda blóma sem þið viljið)
Smyrjið vel af rjómaostakremi á milli allra laga á kökunni (x3).

Smyrjið því næst þunnu lagi allan hringinn, bæði á hliðar og topp til að festa kökumylsnu vel fyrir lokaumferð og leyfið að standa í um 15 mínútur áður en haldið er áfram (til að fá smá stökkan hjúp á kremið).
Smyrjið að nýju vel af kremi allan hringinn og fallegt er að mynda rákir/toppa með spaðanum og engar áhyggjur þarf að hafa af því að slétta kremið, það má vera óreglulegt.
Raðið því næst þurrkuðum ananasblómum á kökuna til að skreyta hana.
steps: Mix the vegetable oil, vanilla drops, sugar, and granulated sugar in a mixer bowl and stir until well combined. Add the eggs one at a time, beating well in between so the mixture becomes yellowish and slightly airy.
Mix in the mashed bananas.
Combine the dry ingredients in a bowl and gently fold them into the egg mixture, a little at a time.
Finally, add the carrots, walnuts, and almonds.
Spray two 20-22cm pans well with cooking oil spray and divide the batter equally between them.
Bake at 175°C for about 30 minutes or until a skewer comes out clean.
Let the layers cool well after removing them from the pans, then cut each one in half with a cake cutter/knife to obtain four thin layers.
Beat the butter until light and fluffy.
Add the cream cheese, vanilla drops, and vanilla sugar and mix well.
Add the powdered sugar to the mixture in small amounts until everything is well combined and smooth.
Peel the pineapple whole, following its length.

Cut “nicks” around the entire circumference using a zester/knife. This creates small holes around the ring, which will make the flowers more beautiful. Next, try to cut thin enough slices that you can see the knife through them.
Thread each slice and arrange them on parchment paper on a baking sheet.

Bake at 110°C for about 30 minutes, then flip the slices and continue heating for about 30 minutes or until the pineapple begins to dry. Be careful not to burn it and watch closely after flipping. Nevertheless, it is important to bake it long enough; if there is still any juice or if it doesn't feel dry enough, you must flip it back and bake for a few additional minutes on each side.
Place each pineapple slice in a muffin tin, an egg carton, or something similar that provides a convex shape once the slice has dried.
It is good to prepare the pineapple flowers the day before, assemble them on the cake, and allow them to dry in their molds overnight.

title: Soccer Pitch Vanilla Birthday Cake
desc: Classic vanilla sheet cake decorated like a lush green football pitch with piped buttercream.
steps: 1 egg
2 tsp vanilla drops
3 tbsp syrup

title: Vibrant Six-Layer Rainbow Cake
desc: Six vibrant sponge layers frosted inside and out with fluffy vanilla buttercream rosettes.
ingredients: x hvítt kökumix eða 2 x þessi uppskrift
Matarlitir (gulur, appelsínugulur, rauður, grænn, fjólublár og blár)
steps: Prepare a double batch of vanilla batter in a stand mixer.
Divide the batter equally into 6 bowls and color with food coloring (use plenty of coloring as it will fade during baking).
Bake the layers and let them cool completely (note that the baking time is shorter than usual as these are thin layers).
Level the layers with a cake leveler, thread, or knife so they are all the same height.
Prepare the frosting and also divide it into 6 bowls, coloring them with the same colors. Make a little extra pink, as it is good to cover the cake with that color since it will be the top layer.
Begin assembling the cake: purple first, then blue, green, yellow, orange, and red (pink), always adding a layer of frosting of the same color on top of each layer.
Then, cover the cake with a thin layer of pink frosting before piping the stars on.
Pipe irregularly, one color at a time; if you only have one piping tip, you can rinse it between colors.
Remember to pipe the stars closely together with a somewhat flat base so they adhere well to the sides.
I also encourage you to check out the rainbow cupcakes here on the site if you want more ideas for the weekend, and I will surely post more colorful entries for the weekend. 🙂
All ingredients for these recipes can be found at Nettó.
Enjoy!

title: Pony Pastel Rainbow Cake
desc: Layered rainbow sponge cake with chocolate buttercream filling and whimsical pastel vanilla rosettes.
ingredients: x Betty Crocker Devils Food cake mix, bakað í 2 x 20cm formum
steps: Place all ingredients except powdered sugar and cocoa into a stand mixer bowl and mix well.
Sift the powdered sugar and cocoa together and gently add to the mixture, scraping down the sides, and mix until the frosting is smooth and creamy.
Place all ingredients except powdered sugar into a stand mixer bowl and mix well.
Gently add the powdered sugar to the mixture, scraping down the sides, and mix until the frosting is smooth and creamy.
Color with your desired food coloring and begin by coating the entire cake with a thin layer of frosting.
Pipe "dots" vertically down the side of the cake and pull each color out with a spatula; repeat with small intervals until you have completed the circle.

title: Salted Caramel Dream Cake
desc: Multi-layer vanilla sponge filled with homemade salted caramel sauce and caramel buttercream.
steps: Preheat oven to 185°C.
Spray three 15 cm cake pans with cooking spray and line the bottoms with parchment paper.
Cream together the butter and both types of sugar until light and fluffy.
Add the eggs one at a time, scraping down the sides well.
Combine all dry ingredients in a bowl, then add to the mixture alternately with the applesauce, scraping down as needed.
Divide the batter equally into the three pans and smooth the tops; note that the batter is very thick.
Bake for 5<0xA0>50-60 minutes or until a skewer comes out clean.
Let cool completely and level the tops with a knife or cake leveler. Then, slice each layer in half to create six thinner layers.
Sufficient for the frosting, drizzle, and coating several apples.
400 g sugar
200 g butter at room temperature
270 ml heavy cream
1 ½ tsp salt
Have all ingredients ready at the start, as the mixture requires constant stirring.
Place the sugar in a pot and heat over medium heat until melted, stirring constantly with a spoon (this takes about 6-8 minutes).
Add the butter to the sugar (it will bubble slightly, which is normal) and stir well until combined.
Pour the cream into the pot and stir well until combined. It will bubble again; you may increase the heat for 1-2 minutes at this stage before removing from heat and adding the salt.
It is a good idea to pour the caramel into another bowl (I immediately set aside 120 ml in a measuring cup for the frosting and the rest in a larger bowl).
The caramel must reach room temperature before it can be used in the frosting, drizzle, or for the caramel apples.
If it becomes too thick before making the drizzle, you can microwave it on medium heat for 10-15 seconds and stir again (it can still be quite thick, as it flows remarkably well even then).
For layering and the base coating of the cake.
230 g butter at room temperature
480 g powdered sugar
2 tsp vanilla drops
120 ml caramel sauce (see recipe above)
Cream the butter until light and fluffy.
Gradually add the powdered sugar in several portions.
Add the vanilla drops and the caramel sauce and mix well.
Spread an even amount between the layers and coat the cake with a thin base layer.
For the final coating of the cake.
2 x Betty Crocker Vanilla frosting
200 g powdered sugar
Mix well in a stand mixer bowl and spread a 1 cm thick layer over the entire cake to cover it.

Take a generous amount of chopped hazelnuts and press them lightly against the bottom edge of the cake with your palm. It is helpful to place an oven tray underneath to catch any falling nuts to reuse them. Repeat until you have achieved the desired "hazelnut ring" at the base of the cake.
Pour the caramel in several small portions over the top and allow it to drip slightly down the sides; be careful not to pour too much at the edge, as the caramel will flow down significantly.
Finally, dip the apple into the caramel sauce so it is fully coated, then place it in the center of the cake.
Sprinkle hazelnuts on the apple and around it.
Delicious!

title: New Year Red Velvet Cake
desc: Velvety cocoa-infused red sponge layered with smooth vanilla cream cheese frosting.
steps: Bake according to the package instructions, with the exception that one extra egg is added and a little red food coloring is added if you want a stronger red color (this is optional).
Bake in two 20 cm cake pans, then slice each layer in half to obtain 4 thinner layers.
Mix the canned frosting with powdered sugar until it is stiff and smooth.
Spread between the layers (3 layers).
Cover the entire cake with a thin layer to "bind" the crumbs and prepare for the buttercream decoration.
Use Wilton piping tip no. 125 or another similar petal tip and pipe irregular lace patterns; remember to keep the narrow end facing away from the cake.

I thought the cake looked incredibly beautiful before the final decoration, though the gold balls and stars make it look more festive for New Year's. Before I added the decorations, I thought it looked very bridal and would not be a bad idea to decorate a wedding cake this way.

title: Chocolate Cake with Whipped Dumle Caramel
desc: Tender chocolate cake layered with melted Dumle toffee cream and vanilla buttercream.
steps: Melt caramels and butter together over medium heat until well combined. If the mixture separates or thickens too much, you can add a little cream and stir well.
Place the caramel in a stand mixer bowl and gently stir in the cocoa and vanilla drops, followed by the powdered sugar, one cup at a time, mixing well between additions.
Divide into 3 portions and spread between the cake layers.
Place all ingredients except the powdered sugar in a stand mixer bowl and mix well.
Gently add the powdered sugar to the mixture, scraping down the sides, and beat until the frosting is smooth and velvety.
Sometimes you may need to add a little more powdered sugar if you want the frosting to be stiffer.
Add yellow food coloring at the end.

This time, I used Wilton piping tip no. 125 to achieve this "lace pattern." First, cover the entire cake with a thin layer of yellow frosting, then pipe the pattern on. Hold the wider end of the tip close to the side, start at the bottom, zigzag upwards, and finish by tapering the line toward the center. It is perfectly fine to lift the tip away if you get tired and start again.

title: Six-Layer Celebration Torte
desc: Spectacular six-tier chocolate cake layered with cocoa buttercream and delicate white vanilla pearls.
steps: Cream together granulated sugar and butter until light and fluffy.
Add the eggs one at a time, scraping down the sides.
Beat this mixture on high speed until airy, then add the vanilla drops.
Mix together the dry ingredients (flour, cocoa, baking soda, and salt) and alternate adding them to the sour cream.
Mix gently until well combined, then add the boiling water.
Divide into cake tins (3 x approx. 20cm tins, then each layer is split into 2 using a skewer/cake cutter).
Bake for about 35 minutes at 170°C.
Place all ingredients except the powdered sugar and cocoa in a stand mixer bowl and mix well.
Mix the powdered sugar and cocoa together and gently add to the mixture, scraping down the and beat until the frosting is smooth and velvety.
If the frosting is too stiff to spread between the layers, you can add a little water.

• 500g powdered sugar
• 1 egg
• 2 tsp vanilla drops
• 2 tbsp syrup
Place all ingredients except the powdered sugar in a stand mixer bowl and mix well.
Gently add the powdered sugar to the mixture, scraping down the sides, and beat until the frosting is smooth and velvety.
Divide into 3 bowls and color with white, red, and blue.
Use round piping tips between 1-1.5cm in diameter, then use a small spoon to pull each dollop.

title: Festive Frosted Spiced Bundt
desc: Richly spiced Nordic holiday cake infused with cinnamon, cloves and ginger, topped with sweet glaze.
steps: Preheat oven to 170°C.
Whisk together eggs, water, and melted butter.
Add the cake mix along with cinnamon, scraping down the sides, until the batter is smooth and fine.
Finally, add the Royal pudding powder and mix well again.
Spray three 20cm tins with cooking oil spray and divide the batter among the tins.
Bake for about 30 minutes or until a skewer comes out clean.
Let the cake layers cool well, then trim the tops with a cake leveler to ensure they are even and smooth.
Whip together butter, cream cheese, and Mascarpone until light and fluffy.
Add the powdered sugar in several batches, along with milk, vanilla drops, and salt.
Beat until a smooth and beautiful frosting has formed.
Spread a layer about 1 cm thick between the layers and on the top, and lightly coat the sides with frosting so the layers are still visible through it.
Decorate and refrigerate until ready to serve.
Bring 100g sugar and water to a boil, stirring until the sugar is dissolved, then remove from heat.
Dip rosemary sprigs into the sugar syrup, shake off the excess, and place them on parchment paper for about 15 minutes.
Next, place the cranberries in a pot, cover with a lid or kitchen towel, and let them sit in the pot for about 15 minutes.
Remove the cranberries, shake off as much sugar syrup as possible, and place them on parchment paper for about 30 minutes.
While the cranberries rest, place 200g of sugar in a shallow, wide bowl and roll the rosemary sprigs in the sugar, then place them on a new piece of clean parchment paper to dry.
Once the cranberries have dried for about 30 minutes, they can also be rolled in sugar and moved to a new piece of parchment paper to dry.
Letting this sit for about 15-30 minutes should be sufficient, then use as desired to decorate the cake.
If this cake doesn't get you in the Christmas spirit, I don't know what will!

title: Gingerbread Molasses Cake
desc: Aromatic gingerbread cake packed with crushed gingerbread cookies and cream cheese frosting.
ingredients: Fínt rifinn börkur af einni appelsínu

Raðið rósmarínstönglum saman svo þeir myndi
nokkurs konar jólatré og stingið piparkökufígúrum í kremið.

Stráið flórsykri yfir allt með fínu sigti svo
það líti út fyrir að það hafi snjóað.
Kælið kökuna þar til bera á hana fram.
steps: Preheat oven to 170°C.
Grease three 15cm baking tins with butter or cooking oil spray and line the bottoms with parchment paper.
Mix the dry ingredients together in a stand mixer bowl.
Add the butter cubes (approx. 1x1 cm, can be straight from the fridge) and mix until the butter is incorporated so that the texture resembles sand or breadcrumbs.
Whisk the eggs in a bowl and add them to the mixture in several batches.
Next, add the syrup, orange zest, orange juice, milk, and vanilla drops; mix on low speed and scrape down the sides a few times.
Finely chop the candied ginger and fold it into the batter at the end.
Divide the batter between the tins; I weighed about 430g into each tin.

Bake until a skewer comes out with a few crumbs but not wet batter, then let them cool in the tins for about 15 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. The layers can then be trimmed and leveled before assembling the cake.
Whip together butter and cream cheese with the mixer until light and fluffy, scraping down the sides a few times.
Add salt and vanilla bean seeds.
Next, add the powdered sugar to the mixture in several batches, scraping down the sides, and beat until a smooth and beautiful frosting has formed.
Spread a layer about 1 cm thick between the layers and on the top, and lightly coat the sides with frosting so the layers are clearly visible through it.
We found these reindeer gingerbread molds at Byggt og búið in Kringlan.

title: Old-Fashioned Layered Chocolate Torte
desc: Traditional Nordic chocolate sponge layered with classic cooked buttercream.
ingredients: Mmmm, það er erfitt að standast sneið af henni þessari!
Megið endilega líka fylgja Gotterí á Instagram
steps: Preheat the oven to 175°C.
Place öll þurrefnin in the stand mixer bowl.
Whisk the eggs in a bowl/könnu and add buttermilk, matarolíu and vanilla extract together.
Pour súrmjólkurblöndunni gently together þurrefnin and mix together until slétt deig hefur myndast, scraping down the bowl.
Klippið parchment paper in the cake layer on tveimur 20-22 cm kökuformum and spread kantana well/spray with matarolíuspreyi.
Bake for about 40 minutes or until prjónn kemur út aðeins with a little kökumylsnu on endanum, ekki blautu deigi.
Cool the cake layers completely and slice ofan af þeim til að slétta then örlítið before the frosting and fyllingin is sett on.
Whisk the butter and add the remaining hráefnunum gently together alternating.
Skafið well down on milli and whisk finally in nokkrar minutes.
Place annan kökubotninn on kökudisk and spread with vænu lagi af jarðarberja- and rabarbarasultu.
Next you can setja súkkulaðikrem, um 1 cm þykkt over sultuna and finally dreifa úr stappaða banananum over the frosting.
Then you can leggja seinni the cake layer ofan on and smyrja kremi on hliðarnar and toppinn.
Þessi kaka minnti mig óneitanlega on ömmu Guðrúnu then ég sótti að sjálfsögðu mánaðarstellið which ég erfði frá henni and notaði þennan daginn.

title: Chocolate Cake with Mocha Buttercream
desc: Espresso-infused chocolate sponge layers filled with silky mocha buttercream.
ingredients: Mér þætti vænt um að þið fylgduð Gotterí líka á INSTAGRAM
steps: Preheat the oven to 170°C.
Spread 3 x 15 cake pan well with smjöri and sigtið cocoa powder over, klippið einnig parchment paper in the cake layer.
Place öll þurrefnin in the stand mixer bowl (sigtið the cocoa powder together).
Place next eggs, vanilla extract, matarolíu and buttermilk together in a bowl and whisk together.
Pour hot coffee together eggjablönduna in mjórri bunu and stir well in meanwhile.
Pour finally allri eggjablöndunni in the stand mixer bowl, mix together þurrefnin and scrape down until þunnt and slétt deig hefur myndast.
Divide evenly between the cake pans and Bake for 30-35 minutes or until a tester comes out with a few moist crumbs endanum en ekki blautu deigi.
Stir öllu together meðalháan hraða in nokkrar minutes until létt, ljósbrúnt krem hefur myndast, scraping down the bowl.
Sjóðið together sugar and water við meðalháan hita until sykurinn is uppleystur.
Veltið rósmaríngreinum upp úr sykurleginum, hristið eins mikið af vökvanum af and þið getið and place on parchment paper in um hour.

Pour then um 200 g af sugar in a bowl and veltið sykurlegnum greinunum upp úr the sugar and hristið af eins and þið getið, place on nýjan parchment paper and allow að þorna in að minnsta kosti hour before þið decorate kökuna with þeim.
Place kökubotn on disk and spread um 1 cm þykku lagi af kremi ofan on hann.
Place næsta botn ofan on and endurtakið leikinn.
Finally fer þriðji the cake layer ofan on and kakan is hjúpuð þunnt on hliðunum and with um 1 cm þykku lagi on toppnum.

Smooth next toppinn and skafið then well af hliðunum with rökum spatula til að fá „naked cake“ útlit on kökuna. Það fer a little krem again upp fyrir kantinn en það gefur kökunni a little „rustic“ útlit then endilega allow því bara að vera þannig in stað þess að slétta completely.
Cool the cake completely then the frosting stífni well and decorate then with rósmarín jólatrjám and bindið brúnan bandspotta um kökuna miðja.

Það is lítið mál að útbúa sykruð jólatré úr rósmarín then alls ekki láta það stoppa ykkur. Ég hef líka verið on hraðferð with svona skreytingar and then you can stinga stönglunum beint in kökuna and sigta a little icing sugar over til að bjarga sér.

title: Toasted Coconut Vanilla Layer Cake
desc: Light vanilla sponge frosted with coconut buttercream and coated with toasted coconut flakes.
ingredients: x Betty Crocker Vanilla Cake Mix
steps: Preheat the oven to 160°C and penslið 3 x 15 cm cake pan well with matarolíu.
Stir together eggjum, matarolíu, water and kókosrjóma in hrærivélarskálinni.
Add kökuduftinu together and stir on medium speed in nokkrar minutes, scraping down the bowl.
Add finally kókosmjölinu in the batter and mix létt.
Divide the batter evenly between the cake pans and bake until prjónn kemur hreinn út (um 25 minutes).
Stir together butter and cream cheese until létt and ljóst.
Add öðrum hráefnum together alternating and scraping down the bowl.
Whisk until létt and ljóst krem hefur myndast.
Spread rúmlega 1 cm af kremi on milli the cake layers and hjúpið kökuna with þunnu lagi af kremi, cool until the frosting fer að taka sig (um 30 minutes).
Spread then næstu umferð af kremi on alla kökuna til að þekja hana well and smooth well úr toppnum and hliðunum.
Take fulla lúku in senn af kókosmjöli and rennið upp hliðarnar frá botni and upp að toppi. Gott is að gera þetta over bökunarskúffu til þess að umfram kókosmjöl geti hrunið down in skúffuna.
Þegar hliðarnar are well þaktar kókosmjöli you can setja krem in piping bag with stórum stjörnustút (t.d 2D frá Wilton) and sprauta 8 toppa allan hringinn efst on kökunni.
Finally you can setja Lindor kúlu on hvern smjörkremstopp and geyma then kökuna in the refrigerator.
Mmmmm…….

title: Vanilla Sponge with Salted Caramel Cream
desc: Tender vanilla cake filled with homemade amber caramel and fluffy whipped cream.
ingredients: „Naked Cake“ með súkkulaði, karamellu og vanillu ívafi
steps: Preheat the oven to 160°C° and stir eggjum, oil and water together.
Add kökuduftinu together and stir in nokkrar minutes, then you can bæta búðingsduftinu við and blanda stutta stund til viðbótar.
Divide down in 3 x 15 cm cake pan which búið is að spreya well að innan with matarolíuspreyi.
Bake for about 25 minutes or until þið sjáið að kantarnir losna örlítið frá forminu efst, cool.
Pour the sugar on pönnu and heat við háan hita until hann fer að kristallast, stir mjög reglulega.
Þegar hann byrjar að bráðna you can lækka hitann in meðalháan and hræra áfram until sykurinn is uppleystur.
Then you can bæta the butter on pönnuna and hræra well and next the cream and hræra until samfelld caramel hefur myndast. Hér is the salt then hrært together.
Take af hitanum and pour in a bowl, allow to cool before notað with the frosting.
Whisk the butter until létt and ljóst.
Add icing sugar, vanillusykri and cream together in several additions.
Skafið well down on milli and stir until létt krem hefur myndast.

Slice aðeins ofan af öllum kökubotnunum and spread um ½ sm þykku lagi af smjörkremi ofan on neðsta the cake layer and next smjörkremsvegg with round piping tip yst on the cake layer (þetta gert til þess að karamellan leki ekki út). fill upp in with saltkaramellu.
Place botn númer 2 ofan on and endurtakið and lokið then with þriðja the cake layer and Cool the cake completely in um 30 minutes.
Hjúpið next alla kökuna with þunnu lagi af smjörkremi and cool again in um 10 minutes.

Then you can setja lokaumferð af kremi on kökuna which is um 1 sm þykkt smjörkremslag. before þið smooth úr the frosting you can setja a little af karamellu hér and þar with skeið/hníf and draga with the frosting þegar það is sléttað with kökuspaða. finally a little strá a little grófu salt efst on kökuna and best is að geyma hana in the refrigerator.
Vanillu kökuduftið frá Betty finnst mér virkilega ljúffengt and að gera kökupinna with því is himneskt, svona if þið ætlið að fara út in frekari kökugerð en þessa hér!

title: Cookies & Cream Champion Cake
desc: Dark chocolate cake filled and frosted with generous heaps of crushed Oreo buttercream.
ingredients: Ó svo mikið falleg og góð!
steps: Preheat the oven to 170°C.
Stir together öllum þurrefnum in eina a bowl and place aside.
Whisk the eggs and mix buttermilk, oil, vanilla extract and water together.
Pour vökvanum gently together þurrefnin, stir and scraping down the bowl (the batter is þunnt).
Prepare 4 x 15 cm springform pan, Line the base of the pan with baking parchment and spray well with matarolíuspreyi.
Divide the batter evenly between the cake pans and Bake for about 25-35 minutes or until a tester comes out with a few moist crumbs en ekki blautu deigi.
Cool completely and slice then ofan af the cake layers then þeir verði completely sléttir and cool then.
Place Oreokex in food processor/blandara and myljið down in duft, store.
Whisk butter and cream cheese together in nokkrar minutes, scraping down the bowl.
Add icing sugar, cream and vanillusykri together in several additions and skafið well down.
Place um 2/3 Oreo mylsnunnar in the frosting and mix well (store restina til skrauts).
Spread um 1 cm þykki lagi af kremi on milli the cake layers and hjúpið with örþunnu lagi, cool in um 15 minutes.
Place nú seinna kremlagið on and það you can vera um ½ – 1 cm on þykkt, smooth úr eins and best verður on kosið.
Place Oreomylsnu neðst on kökuna with lófanum and þjappið laust að, hreinsið umfram mylsnu burt.
Cool the cake completely again in um 15 minutes and place next ganaché on toppinn (sjá uppskrift að neðan).
Heat the cream að suðu and pour over the chocolate.

Whisk together until allt the chocolate is melted, stir until byrjar aðeins að þykkna and pour óreglulega over toppinn in several additions, ýtið örlitlu magni fram af brúninni with kökuspaða, cool in um 15 minutes before þið decorate.
Stingið Oreokexi létt ofan in súkkulaðitoppinn with jöfnu millibili allan hringinn.
Pipe smjörkremstoppa, til dæmis with piping tip 2D frá Wilton and fill upp in bilið on milli kexanna. store kökuna in the refrigerator fram að notkun.

title: Chocolate Cake with Cream Cheese Frosting
desc: Moist chocolate sponge paired with a luscious, slightly tangy vanilla cream cheese frosting.
steps: Preheat the oven to 170°C.
Stir together öllum þurrefnum in eina a bowl and place aside.
Whisk the eggs and mix buttermilk, oil, vanilla extract and water together.
Pour vökvanum gently together þurrefnin, stir and scraping down the bowl (the batter is þunnt and það on að vera þannig).
Prepare 4 x 15 cm form and 3 x 20 cm form, Line the base of the pan with baking parchment and spray well að innan with matarolíuspreyi.

Divide the batter evenly between the cake pans (fyrra the batter in þessi fjögur 15 cm form and seinna deigi in þessi þrjú 20 cm form) and Bake for about 30-35 minutes or until a tester comes out with a few moist crumbs en ekki blautu deigi.
Cool the cake layers well and slice then ofan af the cake layers then þeir verði completely sléttir and cool then.
Whisk butter and cream cheese together in nokkrar minutes, scraping down the bowl.
Add icing sugar, cream and vanillusykri together in several additions and skafið well down.

Spread um 1 cm þykku lagi af kremi on milli the cake layers on hvorri köku and hjúpið að utan with þunnu lagi then það sjáist in hliðarnar on the cake layers. Það you can þó vera meira krem on toppnum sjálfum. Athugið að minni kakan þarf að sitja on pappaspjaldi til þess að geta farið ofan on hina síðar.

Skafið hliðarnar sléttar and if krem ýtist upp on toppinn on köntunum eins and on þessari köku is náttúrulegt and skemmtilegt að leyfa því bara að standa þannig in stað þess að draga það inn on kökuna sjálfa and slétta úr því.

Cool hvora köku um sig well, gott að setja then minni in frystinn in um hour before þið lyftið henni over on hina. place stoðir in neðri kökuna and lyftið hinni ákveðið ofan on hana and decorate finally with ferskum blómum or því which hugurinn girnist.
Fermingarskiltið is frá Hlutprent eins and then oft before þar is possible to láta hanna kökuskilti eftir eigin óskum.

title: Sour Candy Confetti Cake
desc: Playful rainbow cake layered with smooth vanilla buttercream and crowned with sour candy drops.
ingredients: Það þarf bara smá þolinmæði til að raða þessu allan hringinn, ekki annað!
steps: Preheat the oven to 170°C and prepare 5 x 15 cm cake pan. Klippið smjörpappír in the cake layer and spreyjið well with matarolíuspreyji að innan.
Blandi flour, baking powder and salt together in a bowl, store.
Beat butter and sugar together until light, pale, and fluffy.
Add then eggjahvítunum together, in nokkrum hlutum and scraping down the bowl.
Next fara vanilludroparnir together and then hveitiblandan and „buttermilk“ alternating. stir on low speed and skafið then down and mix in nokkrar seconds again.
Mix finally sour the cream gently together.
Divide the batter down in 5 bowls and color with yellow, appelsínugulu, red, green and blue.
Place in the pans and Bake for about 25-30 minutes or until prjónn kemur hreinn út.
Cool before þið prepare the frosting and place kökuna together.
Whisk the butter until létt.
Add then icing sugar and cream together alternating, scraping down the bowl and whisk well.
Place finally salt and vanilla extract together and whisk aðeins til viðbótar.
Place um 5 matskeiðar af kremi in senn in a bowl and color in sama lit and botnarnir.
Ég byrjaði on bláa the cake layer and setti bláa the frosting ofan on, gott is að the frosting sé um 1 cm að þykkt.
Then you can setja græna ofan on, gera grænt krem and þannig koll af kolli.
Finally fer guli the cake layer ofan on and then you can lita alla the remaining the frosting gult and grunnhjúpa kökuna with þunnu lagi af kremi.

Eftir um 30 minutes you can then setja næsta lag af kremi on kökuna and gott að hafa það um ½-1 cm on þykkt. smooth hliðarnar and toppinn eftir fremsta megni and raðið then Sour Patch Kids hlaupi on hliðarnar eins and myndin sýnir. Alltaf tveir and tveir eins, hlið við hlið and vinnið þetta lóðrétt, alltaf ein lína completely upp.
Then rúlla litirnir alltaf down þannig að „ombre“ mynstur komi on hlaupkarlana.
Þegar búið is að þekja kökuna with Sour Patch Kids you can setja the remaining the frosting in piping bag with stórum stjörnustút (ég notaði 2 D frá Wilton).

Pipe 8 jafna toppa ofan on kökuna við kantana, sprinkle kökuskrauti ofan on then and in miðjuna and place Sour Patch Kids hlaupkarla on milli toppanna. Einnig is possible to raða hlaupkörlunum first and sprauta then toppana and skreyta with kökuskrautinu.
Þetta is in rauninni bara vanillu kaka with vanillu kremi, lituð in öllum regnbogans litum and skreytt with þessu krúttlega and litríka hlaupi.

title: Cute Kitty Vanilla Celebration Cake
desc: Whimsical cat-themed vanilla sponge with delicate piped buttercream ears and whiskers.
steps: Preheat the oven to 170°C.
Stir together öllum þurrefnum in eina a bowl and place aside.
Whisk the eggs and mix buttermilk, oil, vanilla extract and water together.
Pour vökvanum gently together þurrefnin, stir and scraping down the bowl (the batter is þunnt).
Prepare 4 x 15 cm springform pan, Line the base of the pan with baking parchment and spray well with matarolíuspreyi.
Divide the batter evenly between the cake pans and Bake for about 25-35 minutes or until a tester comes out with a few moist crumbs en ekki blautu deigi.
Cool completely and slice then ofan af the cake layers then þeir verði completely sléttir and cool then.
Whisk the butter stutta stund.
Add öðrum hráefnum together the butter alternating, scraping down the bowl and stir well.
Þegar létt and þétt krem hefur myndast you can smyrja því on milli the cake layers and raða kökunni together fyrir hjúp.
Whisk the butter stutta stund.
Add öðrum hráefnum together alternating, scraping down the bowl and whisk until létt and ljóst.
Spread first þunnu lagi over allt til að hjúpa kökuna, Store in the refrigerator in um 30 minutes.
Color hluta af the frosting in þeim tónum which þið ætlið að skreyta with and place in piping bag and store.

Hjúpið kökuna að nýju with white kremi, nú um ½ cm þykkt lag allan hringinn (use a little litað krem if þið viljið draga lit in eins and is gert neðarlega on þessari köku) and decorate að vild. Hér are sprautaðar roses and stjörnur in mismundi gerðum and skreytt with kökuskrauti.
Prepare eyru and stjörnur, allow því að storkna over nótt and color then with duftmatarlitum.
Teiknið augu, munn and veiðihár with fínum pensli and matarlit.
Place then a little krem on hverja stjörnu before þið festið þær on hliðarnar.

title: Cinnamon Spiced Gingerbread Cake
desc: Cozy cinnamon sponge layered with gingerbread buttercream and spiced biscuit crumb.
steps: Preheat the oven to 170°C.
Place butter, golden syrup and brown sugar in a saucepan and melt together meðalhita in nokkrar minutes, remove from heat.
Place öll þurrefnin (+ piparkökumylsnuna) in the stand mixer bowl and pour the sugar mixture úr pottinum together ásamt eggjum and buttermilk.

Stir until well combined and divide then down in 4 x 15cm cake pan which búið is að smyrja well að innan and setja parchment paper in the cake layer. Það fara rúmlega 400 g in hvert form if þið eruð að vigta.
Bake for about 27-30 minutes or until a tester comes out with a few moist crumbs endanum en ekki blautu deigi, cool before þið prepare the frosting.
Whisk the butter until létt and ljóst.
Add icing sugar, vanilla extract and cream together in several additions, stir well and scraping down the bowl.
Stir until the frosting is orðið létt and airy and light.
Spread um 1 cm þykku lagi af kremi on milli botna and hjúpið then kökuna að utan with kremi. Skafið þó mesta the frosting af hliðunum til að fá „naked cake“ útlit.
Place the remaining the frosting in piping bag/zip lock poka, place a little krem aftan on piparkökur and piparkökukúlur and decorate eftir ykkar höfði.
Finally you can setja icing sugar in lítið sigti and sigta over kökuna.
Það var einfalt and fallegt að skreyta kökuna with hjartalaga piparkökum and súkkulaðihúðuðum piparkökukúlum.

title: Rainbow Explosion Birthday Cake
desc: Festive rainbow-hued party cake with a vibrant center and whipped frosting.
ingredients: Hellið vökvanum varlega saman við þurrefnin, hrærið og skafið niður á milli.
Skiptið deiginu jafnt á milli formanna um 400 g í hvert og bakið í 28-30 mínútur eða þar til prjónn kemur út með smá kökumylsnu á en ekki blautu deigi.
Kælið alveg og skerið svo ofan af botnunum svo þeir verði sléttir og kælið þá.
Hrærið þar til slétt súkkulaðikrem hefur myndast og skiptið á milli botnanna, hafið gott 1 cm lag á milli.
Kælið kökuna á meðan litaða kremið er undirbúið.
Bætið flórsykri og rjóma til skiptis saman við og skafið niður á milli.
Smyrjið þunnu lagi af hvítu kremi á alla kökuna til að binda kökumylsnu, kælið á meðan þið litið restina af kreminu.
Hrærið upp kremið sem eftir stendur og skiptið því niður í skálar eftir því hversu marga liti þið viljið hafa.
Litið með því að opna mismunandi Litabombur, ég notaði 2-3 hylki í hvern lit en þetta er auðvitað smekksatriði svo notið meira eða minna eftir því sem ykkur þykir fallegt.

Smyrjið einum lit í senn yfir alla kökuna með því að setja aftan á lítinn spaða líkt og sést í myndbandinu hér að ofan. Mikilvægt er að skafa alltaf spaðann á milli til að ekkert krem sé á honum þegar þið smyrjið mismunandi litum á.
Ég mæli sannarlega með því að þið prófið þessa snilld!
steps: Þú getur einnig combined þína eigin colors eins and fjólubláan and appelsínugulan. Vertu ofurhetja in eldhúsinu and búðu til bláa þeytinga, litaðu smjörkremið in öllum regnbogans litum, jógúrtið, sódavatnið or kókosmjöl fyrir náttúrulegt and litríkt kökuskraut!

title: Classic Moist Carrot Cake
desc: No-fuss spiced carrot cake topped with a velvety layer of vanilla cream cheese frosting.
steps: Preheat the oven to 160°C.
Spray round cake pan well að innan with matarolíuspreyi.
Whisk eggs, oil, appelsínusafa, appelsínubörk and vanilla extract together in hrærivélarskálinni.
Add gulrótarkökudufti, cinnamon and engiferdufti in the stand mixer bowl and stir áfram on medium speed and scraping down the bowl.
Add finally rifnum gulrótum together and pour in kökuformið.
Bake for about 35 minutes or until a tester comes out with a few moist crumbs endanum, ekki blautu deigi.
Whisk cream cheese and butter together stutta stund.
Add the icing sugar together in several additions, scrape down and whisk on milli.
Add finally the vanilla extract together and whisk the frosting until kekkjalaust and létt in sér.
Spread over efri hlutann on kökunni.
Þessi kaka kláraðist upp til agna on innan við sólarhring then það segir það which segja þarf!
Mmmm….

title: Holiday Spiced Carrot Cake
desc: Cinnamon and nutmeg spiced carrot cake dressed up with piped holiday buttercream trees.
ingredients: x Betty Crocker Cream Cheese Icing
steps: Preheat the oven to 160°C and spray 3 x 15 cm cake pan well að innan with matarolíuspreyi.
Stir together eggjum, water and oil.
Add gulrótarkökuduftinu together ásamt cinnamon and vanilla extract, mix well together and scraping down the bowl.
Add búðingsduftinu together in lokin and stir stutta stund in viðbót.
Divide the batter evenly between the pans and Bake for about 25 minutes or until a tester comes out with a few moist crumbs endanum, ekki blautu deigi.
Cool the cake layers and slice then ofan af þeim before þið place krem on milli and decorate.
Whisk allt together and scraping down the bowl.
Spread um 1 cm þykku lagi on milli botna and þekið kökuna with örþunnu lagi on hliðunum en um 1 cm þykku lagi on toppnum.

Allow umfram magni að fara aðeins fram af brúninni þegar þið smooth toppinn, take then stóran kökuspaða til að slétta hliðina well. then ýtist aðeins af umfram the frosting again upp on toppinn en in stað þess að „veiða“ það burt eins and gert is þegar þið viljið slétta kanta, then allow þið því að standa svona ósléttu.
Stingið tveimur piparkökuköllum ofan on kökuna, place a little krem on þann þriðja and festið hann on hliðina.
Place then nokkra sykurpúða, Malteserskúlur and a little kókosmjöl over kökuna ásamt því að stinga nokkrum rósmaríngreinum in hana.
Það is then gaman að leika sér with kökumix, það lærði ég meanwhile ég bjó in Bandaríkjunum!
Ég ákvað að prófa þetta Cream Cheese frosting in fyrsta skipti in stað vanillu and það is virkilega ljúffengt.

title: Easter Pastel Chocolate Cake
desc: Rich chocolate sponge dressed in pastel buttercream and adorned with chocolate easter eggs.
steps: Preheat the oven to 170°C.
Line the base of 4 x 15 cm springform pans and spray the interior lightly with baking spray.
Whisk dry ingredients in one bowl and wet ingredients in another.
Place the mixer in gang with þurrefnunum in skálinni and pour blautefnunum gently together.
Stir well and scraping down the bowl, divide evenly between the cake pans.
Bake for 30-35 minutes or until a tester comes out with a few moist crumbs endanum en ekki blautu deigi.
Cool the cake layers completely on a wire rack and slice then aðeins ofan af þeim til að jafna then fyrir skreytingu.
Chop the dark chocolate gróft, melt and allow því then að ná room temperature while preparing the other ingredients.
Beat the butter for a few minutes until light, pale, and fluffy.
Add melted súkkulaðinu then together and mix gently við the butter.
Place icing sugar and cocoa powder together in several additions, stir well and scraping down the bowl.
Add finally vanilla extract and coffee together and stir well.
Byrjið on því að saxa the dark chocolate gróft down and bræða það.

Búið next til ílangar súkkulaðiplötur with því að dreifa úr melted súkkulaðinu with kökuspaða (þær fara then utan um alla kökuna then gerið þær nógu langar til að hylja fjóra botna + krem). Place in the refrigerator and allow að storkna. Þetta is possible to gera before byrjað is að baka kökubotnana.
Spread um 1- 1,5 cm þykku kremi on milli the cake layers and then you can setja um 1 cm lag af kremi utan on hana alla and slétta aðeins úr.
Grease thoroughly af kremi on toppinn and raðið then súkkulaðiplötum allan hringinn and reynið að hylja the frosting eftir fremsta megni.
Decorate finally toppinn with páskaeggjum and ferskum blómum.

title: Bakery-Style Frosted Carrot Cake
desc: Ultra-moist double-layer carrot cake with a generous crown of cream cheese frosting.
steps: Preheat the oven to 170°C and spray 3 x 15 cm springform pan að innan with matarolíuspreyi (einnig gott að setja parchment paper in the cake layer first en ekki nauðsynlegt).
Stir together öll þurrefnin in hrærivélarskálinni and store.
Whisk next together eggs, oil, buttermilk and vanilla extract, mix gently together þurrefnin on low speed.
Skafið the batter aðeins down on milli and add then rifnum gulrótum together.
Divide the batter next down in the pans (um 410-420 g in hvert) and Bake for about 40 minutes or until a tester comes out with a few moist crumbs endanum en ekki blautu deigi.
Cool the cake layers and slice then aðeins ofan af þeim til að jafna then fyrir samsetningu.
Beat the butter until light, pale, and fluffy.
Add then cream cheese, vanilla extract and cream together and mix together.
Add icing sugar together in several additions and skafið and whisk well on milli.
Spread góðu 1 cm lagi af kremi on milli the cake layers and þekið kökuna then að utan with þunnu lagi af kremi, nema um 1 cm on toppnum.
Pipe then small toppa ofan on alla kökuna and place Cadbury eggs on hvern topp. Gott is að nota stóran stjörnustút líkt and 1 M or 2 D frá Wilton.
Store kökuna in the refrigerator.
Það you can einnig baka þetta deig which skúffuköku or bollakökur en then þarf bara að fylgjast well with and aðlaga bökunartímann að slíku.

title: Spring Blossom Meringue Cake
desc: Crisp brown-sugar meringue layers filled with vanilla whipped cream and fresh strawberries.
steps: Prentið út tölustafi which fylla um það bil út in A3 blað. Dragið útlínur in gegn on parchment paper. Látið tölustafinn snúa öfugt þannig að þegar búið is að baka marengsinn sé possible to snúa við on kökudisk.
Bake for 90 minutes on blæstri at 120°C. allow marengsinum að kólna in um hour in the oven before hann is tekinn út.

Before þið place lyftiduftið, Rice Crispies and möndluflögur út in marengsinn take then smávegis aside and place in a bowl til að búa til roses. Blandaði bleikum, rauðum and bláum matarlit út in til að fá lillabláan lit on marengsinn. Búið til roses (1M stútur frá Wilton) and dropa (8B stútur frá Wilton) and látið bakast with tölustafnum in 90 minutes. before rósirnar and droparnir are bakaðir you can strá over a little kökuskrauti and leyfa því að bakast with.

Pipe then cream (with a little icing sugar) on marengsbotnana with 8B stútnum and skreytti then with marengsskrautinu, lifandi blómum, berjum (strawberries, raspberries, brómber, kirsuber) and frönskum makkarónum.

Hversu fallegt! Hægt is að finna ótal skreytingarhugmyndir af númerakökum on netinu. Ég sagði við Tinnu að ég þyrfti nauðsynlega að prófa að útbúa eina svona on næstunni and myndi mig langa að búa til númeraköku úr brownie botnum til að prófa eitthvað nýtt then fylgist with þegar að því kemur!

title: Spring Meringue Layer Cake
desc: Light-as-air meringue discs filled with rich whipped cream, berries and chocolate drizzles.
steps: Preheat the oven to 110°C.
Teiknið 3 x 20cm hringi on bökunarplötur (tveir komast fyrir on annarri and einn on hinni).
Chop möndlurnar down and place aside.
Melt dark chocolate and látið standa meanwhile marengsinn is þeyttur.
Whisk together egg whites and salt until froða myndast and add then the sugar together in small additions.
Whisk on hæstu stillingu until topparnir halda sér (nokkrar minutes).
Add then vanillu- and möndludropum together and whisk together.
Pour söxuðum möndlum in the bowl and mix together with sleif.
Finally is melted dark chocolate hrært gently together with sleif en varist að hræra of mikið, fallegt is að hafa marmaraáferð on marengsinum.
Bake in 2 ½ hour and slökkvið then on the oven and allow marengsinum að kólna inn in honum before þið take út.

Fyrir fyllinguna is cream and icing sugar þeytt together and skipt in þrennt, smurt on milli the cake layers and ofan on síðasta the cake layer. then is röspuðu chocolate and karamellumöndlum stráð over toppinn til skrauts.
Best is að setja the cream on milli að minnsta kosti sólahring before kökunnar on að njóta, then verður hún meira djúsí and góð.
Þessar karamellu möndlur are rugl góðar, hvort which þær fara on köku or einar and sér!
Betty bjargar páskunum!
Páskabomba.
Páskatertan 2017.
Páskaleg kaka.
Páska mini bollakökur.
Saltkaramelludraumur.
Súkkulaðikaka with Dumlekremi.
Gómsæt súkkulaðiterta.

title: Dad's Brown Sugar Meringue Cake
desc: Chewy brown sugar meringue discs stacked with lightly sweetened cream and chopped fruit.
steps: Preheat the oven to 130°C.
Beat until stiff peaks form egg whites and brown sugar.
Teiknið hring (um 20cm in diameter) on parchment paper and place pappírinn on sitthvora bökunarplötuna.
Divide stífþeytta marengsnum on milli and smooth út að línunni, take then gaffal and teiknið toppa on marengsinn.
Bake for about 60 minutes, slökkvið on the oven and allow the cake layers að kólna with the oven then þeir falli síður.
Take um 30gr af suðusúkkulaðinu and melt. pour in small poka and klippið a little gat on eitt hornið, rennið next fram and again um þann botn which þið ætlið að hafa ofaná kökunni.
StífWhip the cream until soft peaks form and mix the remaining söxuðu suðusúkkulaðinu gently together.
Spread on milli the cake layers and allow kökunni að stand in ísskáp in amk sólahring before hún is borin fram.
Megið endilega fylgja mér on INSTAGRAM and mér þykir gaman þegar þið merkið mig þar þegar þið prófið uppskriftir!

title: Loaded Candy Shop Meringue Cake
desc: Meringue torte packed with crushed chocolates, caramel candies and fresh whipped cream.
ingredients: Næst helmingur af þeytta rjómanum og ofan á hann helmingur af súkkulaðifyllingunni.
Marengsinn kemur þá á milli og svo aftur restin af rjómanum og súkkulaðifyllingunni.
Brownie bollakaka með marengs og karamellu
steps: Beat eggs and sugar together until pale and thick.
Sigtið together flour, potato starch and baking powder and add gently together.
Spread um 22 cm springform pan well and Line the base of the pan with baking parchment, Bake at 175°C for about 12-15 minutes or until prjónn kemur hreinn út.
Whisk together egg whites and sugar until topparnir halda sér.
Teiknið um 20 cm hring on parchment paper and spread jafnt úr marengsblöndunni.
Bake at 100°C in tvær klukkustundir.
Whisk egg yolks and icing sugar until the mixture þykkist and lýsist.
Melt the chocolate, allow hitanum að rjúka úr in nokkrar minutes and mix next gently together eggjablönduna.
Whip the cream until soft peaks form and vefjið honum together the chocolate mixture with sleif.
Whip the cream until soft peaks form and melt the dark chocolate.
Mæli with þið skellið in þessa with helgarkaffinu and þið megið endilega fylgja Gotterí on INSTAGRAM.

title: Meringue Dream Torte
desc: Golden baked meringue layers with a chewy marshmallow center and luscious berry cream.
steps: Whisk together egg whites and brown sugar until stífþeytt.
Teiknið hring um 25 cm in diameter on parchment paper and spread marengsblöndunni jafnt in hring.
Bake at 160°C for 45 minutes and allow to cool in the oven.
Whip the cream until soft peaks form and spread over the cake layer.
Slice down Ferrero Rocer kúlur and spread over the cream ásamt Nóakroppi, fallegt is then að sigta a little cocoa powder over allt together in lokin.

title: Daim Crunch Meringue Bomb
desc: Show-stopping meringue cake studded with crunchy Daim toffee and drenched in chocolate sauce.
steps: Preheat the oven to 175°C.

Spray um 20-22cm round springform with matarolíuspreyi (penslið matarolíu on). Einnig finnst mér gott að setja parchment paper on the cake layer and klemma hann fastan with hringnum (then is auðveldara að losa kökuna þegar hún hefur kólnað).
Beat butter and sugar together until light, pale, and fluffy.
Add eggjum and vanilla extract together and scraping down the bowl.
Next fer melted the chocolate in the mixture and finally öll þurrefnin.
Stir gently until combined, taking care not to overmix the batter.
Bake for about 40 minutes or until a tester comes out with moist crumbs but no wet batter.
Cool completely and take then the cake layer in tvennt with kökuskera/tvinna/hníf.
Preheat the oven to 160°C.
